title: Witch's Cauldron Vision
description: A surreal scene centered on a steampunk-style cauldron emitting a swirling vortex of colorful magical energy and glowing orbs. Multiple ethereal female faces with closed eyes and dark floral markings emerge from the swirling hair in vibrant magenta, green, orange, and purple hues, surrounded by butterflies, bees, and a hooded figure holding two flames beside a rippling pool.
prompt: Surreal dark fantasy artwork featuring a large ornate steampunk cauldron at the bottom center with gears and wings, emitting a powerful swirling orange and purple magical vortex filled with glowing colorful orbs and particles. From the swirling colorful smoke emerge multiple overlapping female faces with closed eyes, pale skin, and black floral patterns, their long flowing hair in vibrant magenta, lime green, orange, and purple tones intertwined with gold rings. Butterflies, bees, and moths fly around them. To the right a hooded robed figure stands in a pool of rippling water holding two flaming torches. Dark background with dramatic lighting and intricate details.
